title: GenAI-assisted Scrum artifact workshop
summary: Fourth-year software engineering students work in groups during a two-hour workshop to prompt ChatGPT or Bard for a product vision, epics, values, user stories, and related Scrum artifacts. Groups analyze and compare the outputs after the instructor checks them for errors and hallucinations.

sources.title: Enhancing Student Learning in Scrum Projects with Generative AI Assistance
sources.evidence_quote: During a dedicated two-hour session, the instructor introduced a series of prompts to guide the students' interactions with the AI tools.
